en-us.restroom_expel_question: Sitting on the toilet, $self.name$ can still feel something inside. Push it out?
en-us.restroom_expel_declined: $self.name$ hesitates and leaves what's inside alone.
en-us.restroom_expel_anus: $self.name$ relaxes on the toilet, and what had pooled inside slowly runs out. $restroomAnusMsg$.
en-us.restroom_expel_vagina: $self.name$ bears down, squeezing out what the vagina can't hold. $restroomVaginaMsg$.
en-us.restroom_wipe: $self.name$ wipes down the crotch and thighs with tissue. Wiped: $restroomWipeReport$.
